question: Identify the classical dance form that is the principal dance of Northern India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathak**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Kathak** is one of the eight classical dance forms of India and is primarily associated with **North India**.
 
• The name "Kathak" is derived from the Sanskrit word "**Katha**," which means "story," as the dance form is based on storytelling through expressive movements and gestures.
 
• Kathak has three major gharanas (schools): **Lucknow, Jaipur,** and **Banaras**, each known for its unique style and emphasis on different elements of the dance.
 
• This dance form is characterized by intricate **footwork** (tatkar), graceful movements, and **spins** (chakkars), complemented by facial expressions and hand gestures.
 
• Kathak has a strong connection with both **Hindu mythology** and **Mughal court traditions**, showcasing a blend of devotional and secular themes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Classical Dance Forms of India:** There are eight recognized classical dance forms in India: Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Kathakali, Kuchipudi, Manipuri, Mohiniyattam, Odissi, and Sattriya.
 
• **Gharanas:** The Lucknow gharana emphasizes **grace** and **expressive storytelling**; the Jaipur gharana focuses on **intricate footwork**; and the Banaras gharana is known for its **spiritual themes**.
 
• **Instruments in Kathak:** Common accompanying instruments include the **tabla**, **pakhawaj**, **sitar**, and **sarangi**, which provide rhythm and melody to the performance.
 
• **Costumes:** Traditional Kathak costumes for women include **Anarkali suits** with dupattas, while men wear **kurta-churidar**. Both often feature intricate embroidery and embellishments.
 
• **Bol (Syllables):** Kathak dancers use rhythmic syllables called "**bols**" to synchronize their movements with the music, creating a captivating performance.
